name: facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/config/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.upgrade_config: upgrade a detectron2 CfgNode config from an older version to a newer version
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.downgrade_config: downgrade a detectron2 CfgNode config from a newer version to an older version
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.guess_version: guess the config version from a partial detectron2 CfgNode missing the VERSION field
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.rename_config_keys: rename nested config keys in a detectron2 CfgNode from old dot-notation paths to new ones
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.convert_config_v2: convert a detectron2 config from v1 to v2 by renaming keys and migrating anchor generator settings

facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.build_load_config_file: load a YAML config file and merge it into a CfgNode with automatic version upgrading
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.create_get_default_cfg: create a copy of the default detectron2 config using get_cfg
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.set_global_config_access: set a global config copy accessible anywhere via global_cfg without passing it through code
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.build_configurable_init: decorate a class __init__ with @configurable so it can be called with a CfgNode or regular arguments
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.test_configurable_function: test the @configurable decorator on a standalone function with from_config argument translation

facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.dump_dataclass_dataclass_obj: dump a dataclass instance into a dict with _target_ for later instantiation
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.instantiate_cfg_dict: recursively instantiate objects from a dict using _target_ and keyword arguments
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.instantiate_omegaconf_list: instantiate omegaconf ListConfig elements recursively preserving object references
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.instantiate_omegaconf_dictconfig: convert a DictConfig backed by dataclasses to actual dataclass objects
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.instantiate_nested_target: instantiate nested _target_ entries by resolving string class paths and calling cls(**kwargs)

facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.create_LazyCall: create a LazyCall wrapper around a callable to defer execution and return a config dict with keyword arguments
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.load_LazyConfig: load a python or yaml config file with LazyConfig.load and return omegaconf DictConfig objects
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.save_LazyConfig: save an omegaconf config object to a yaml file with LazyConfig.save, falling back to cloudpickle if needed
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.override_LazyConfig: apply command-line style overrides in 'key=value' format to an omegaconf config object in-place
facebookresearch_detectron2/detectron2/c.convert_LazyConfig: convert an omegaconf config object into human-readable Python-like pseudo code with LazyConfig.to_py
